bloc.A — Facteurs statiques. Énergie par mill:
A — Static factors. Energy per thousand tokens, fixed intensity. Simple, but it underestimates: neither data centre efficiency nor manufacturing.

B — Parametric. Inspired by EcoLogits, Boavizta and ADEME’s Base Empreinte: data centre efficiency (PUE), real-time carbon intensity (RTE éCO#mix), low and high range.

C — Extended life cycle (used). B, plus the embodied impacts (hardware manufacturing, amortised) and the hosting of the request. This is the method shown by default.
bloc.Ce que ce module n'a pas pu vérifier, et: What this module could not verify, and says so. The end date of the transition period for # certificates cannot be reached from this environment. It is confirmed with the certification body, which knows it for every certificate it has issued — and a certificate that has not been migrated ceases to be valid at the end of the transition, whatever the expiry date printed on it.
bloc.Ce que ça change pour un organisme déjà: What this changes for an organisation already certified. What it still has to do is neither #, nor #, nor “everything”: it is the eleven controls that did not exist before — threat intelligence, cloud services, ICT readiness for business continuity, physical security monitoring, configuration management, information deletion, data masking, data leakage prevention, monitoring activities, web filtering, secure coding.
bloc.Chaque appel de modèle est journalisé av: Each model call is logged with the actual token count returned by the API, the latency, the client, the module and the provider. Pages served are aggregated by day. Since all calls go through the server, the count is exhaustive.
bloc.Deux sessions sur site, dans vos locaux,: Two sessions on site, on your premises, a year — included in the Enterprise plan. The other courses in the catalogue are held remotely or in person in Paris.
bloc.EcoLogits (GenAI Impact) — méthodologie:
EcoLogits (GenAI Impact) — methodology for estimating the impacts of models via API, supporting Anthropic and Mistral.
Boavizta — open data on the embodied impacts of hardware.
ADEME — Base Empreinte — emission factors of electricity mixes.
RTE — éCO#mix / ODRÉ — carbon intensity of the French grid in fifteen-minute steps, as open data.

No sentence of the normative text is reproduced, nor any question from the BSI self-assessment questionnaire that served as a starting point — it is the property of its publisher. bloc.L'horloge a deux bornes, et le calcul na: The clock has two limits, and the naive calculation gets the second one wrong. Four hours from classification, twenty-four hours from awareness: whichever expires first governs. But if classification occurs AFTER those twenty-four hours, Article #(#) of Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# treats the case separately — a simple minimum would return a deadline that has already passed.
bloc.La dérogation microentreprise du dernier: The microenterprise derogation in the last subparagraph of paragraph # covers ONLY point (e), and only for a microenterprise. Accepting it elsewhere would pass off an absence as an arrangement provided for by the text.
bloc.La taille ne décide pas du régime, et le: Size does not decide the regime, and confusing the two is costly. Article # defines microenterprise, small and medium-sized enterprise; these definitions serve elsewhere — notably to set aside the rule on recurring incidents. The simplified framework rests on named categories in Article #(#), not on headcount thresholds. A microenterprise that falls into none of the five comes under the full framework.
bloc.Le fait qui coûte le plus cher, et qu'au: The most costly fact, and one that no rate shows. An organisation that has implemented thirty-six controls out of thirty-eight and left two boxes empty fails at stage #. An organisation that includes eighteen and excludes twenty, each one justified, passes. Compliance is not counted in ticked boxes: it is counted in boxes decided.
bloc.Le piège de cette greffe est le périmètr: The trap in this graft is the scope. The ISMS scope is chosen by the organisation; the Regulation’s is not — it covers everything that supports critical or important functions. Carrying the first over as the second is the most common error, and it only shows up in an inspection.
bloc.Le pourcentage affiché mesure une repris: The percentage shown measures evidence carried over, not compliance. It says what share of the articles finds a counterpart in a certified ISMS; it does not say that those articles are met, still less that the authority will accept it.
bloc.Le report au midi du jour ouvrable suiva: The postponement to noon on the next working day (paragraph #) does not apply to the initial notification or the intermediate report of credit institutions, central counterparties, trading venue operators, or essential or important entities under NIS #. For them, the clock runs at the weekend.
bloc.Le risque résiduel s'accepte par le PROP: Residual risk is accepted by the RISK OWNER (clause # e)), not by the CISO or the consultant. It is the clause that turns a technical exercise into a management act, and the one most often missing: an “owner” column filled in, and no dated trace of an acceptance. The auditor asks for the signature, not the name.
bloc.Le taux est donné par chapitre, et le pl: The rate is given per chapter, and the lowest is named. An overall # % obtained with one chapter at # % poorly describes the situation: the weak chapter is precisely the one that will show in an inspection.
bloc.Les AES évaluent ces seuils à partir des: The ESAs assess these thresholds on the basis of the registers of information under Article #(#), which the financial entities keep. The register a bank fills in serves to designate its provider: it is not a declarative formality.
bloc.Les critères d'acceptation se fixent AVA: Acceptance criteria are set BEFORE assessing (clause # a)). Writing them after seeing the results gives a register where everything is acceptable — and that is invisible on reading, since only the order of drafting distinguishes the two. This screen compares the two dates.
bloc.Les mesures de l'annexe A ne sont pas ex: The Annex A controls are not exhaustive: the standard provides that an organisation designs others if risk treatment requires it. Covering all thirty-eight is therefore not enough to make the statement complete — it is complete if it covers the treatment options selected.
bloc.Les trois méthodes sont appliquées aux m: The three methods are applied to the same actual usage data. The gap measures how sensitive the result is to the methodological choice — this is the most useful information from an audit point of view.
bloc.Même énergie consommée, facteurs d'inten: Same energy consumed, different intensity factors. Point of vigilance: the Render hosting is located in Frankfurt; using the French factor would be a methodological error.
bloc.Quatre situations ferment la désignation: Four situations rule out designation in advance (Article #(#)): being a financial entity yourself providing ICT services, coming under an oversight framework pursuant to Article #(#) of the Treaty, being an intragroup provider, or serving only entities active in a single Member State. They are not assessed: they are established.
bloc.Un article de # à # ne se déclare pas «: A clause from # to # cannot be declared “not applicable”: these are requirements, and they cannot be excluded. Only Annex A controls can be, and only with justification. The scope (clause #) is the most structuring decision: everything not excluded from it in writing will be audited.

A clause from # to # cannot be declared “not applicable”: these are requirements, and they cannot be excluded. Only Annex A controls can be excluded, and only with justification (clause # f)). A “not applicable” declaration placed on a clause is ignored by the engine, which says so.
bloc.Un cycle d'audit interne (art. #) et une: An internal audit cycle (clause #) and a management review (clause #) must have taken place before stage #. These are requirements, and they cannot be manufactured the day before: they leave dated traces, or they have not taken place.
bloc.Un plan n'est pas une mesure. Tant qu'un: A plan is not a measure. As long as a measure is not declared implemented, the residual level entered remains a forecast: the module uses the initial level. Serving a planned residual as an achieved one is the most common way of turning a register green without having done anything.
bloc.Un écart important entre les méthodes ne: A significant gap between the methods does not mean that a value is wrong: it means that the scope differs. This is precisely what an auditor checks. Document the method used, its version and its date, and keep the export.
bloc.Une clause absente ne se rattrape pas ap: A missing clause cannot be made up for after signature. The contract has to be reopened, and the provider has no interest in doing so. The two the authority looks at first are the unrestricted right of audit (paragraph #, point (e)) and the exit strategy (paragraph #, point (f)): without the second, the dependency is irreversible and the contract no longer has a real end.
bloc.Une mesure écartée n'a pas de statut de: An excluded control has no implementation status, and must not have one: asking it for one would count as a gap what is a decision. The implementation rate therefore covers only included controls.
bloc.Évaluer une entité du cadre simplifié co: Assessing an entity under the simplified framework against Title II would be the most costly mistake possible: the client would pay for a programme half of which does not apply to it, and would discover this at the first inspection. This screen therefore refuses to work without a declared regime — it does not choose “by default”.
